body.statement: Theorem 4. For fixed \(H\), every \(\varepsilon\in(0,1-\alpha)\), every \(r\), every \(\phi\in\Psi_{\alpha,r}\), and every \(\delta_{\mathrm{sq}}\ge0\) satisfying \(\sqrt{\delta_{\mathrm{sq}}}\le\sqrt{\varepsilon}L_H(V^{\mathrm{quad}}_r)^{1/4}\), \[\inf_{\beta\in\mathcal B_{1,r}(H,\delta_{\mathrm{sq}})}\mathbb E_{Z,U}(\phi\mid\beta)\le\alpha+\varepsilon.\] Here \(L_H=\{h^2/(C_{\cos}\xi_Hv_H)\}^{1/4}\) is computed from the same \(2^h\)-row assignment table and optimized motif variance program as the upper statistic.
body.justification: An all-test converse makes the scale an information bound rather than a quadratic limitation.
body.gap: GaoHarshawSavjeWang2026, arXiv version 2, Proposition 4.1 is an MSE upper envelope supported by Lemmas S3--S4 and has no all-test converse; Tiwari--Basu study power by simulation, and Kandiros et al. target estimation.
body.consumer: The theorem identifies when no analysis of the same Bernoulli arm can reliably detect smaller spillovers.
